verification_method: All five one-day-retention GitHub Actions artifacts were downloaded via connected GitHub, unpacked and SHA256 checksums computed. Each archive contains a source observation/photo attribution JSON and reduced-resolution labeled photographic contact sheets.

23 of the 51 contact sheets covering 143 photo thumbnails were opened in this turn for actual visual inspection. 28 other sheets (174 tiles) were recovered but not visually inspected this turn; previous historical QA is preserved in source branch.
Hays-local provenance reflects the historical iNaturalist Hays county query, not independent revalidation of every geoprivacy setting or herbarium voucher.
Current photo source pages still inaccessible, so all license labels are **archived** metadata. No source license was newly verified and nothing was approved or rehosted.
Full-resolution morphological dissection, expert Hays voucher/local native status, current photo rights and public website pixel verification remain unpassed.

Do not merge source branch wholesale: it contains workflow and historical files, and other chats own the modern scoring/gallery paths. Coordinator may cherry-pick missing archived original QA text files, retaining their provenance.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: One-sided curved racemes, a flowering branch held next to a ruler, hairy node/collar, detached flower/spikelet units set beside ruler.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Contact sheet does not reliably show exact fertile-versus-sterile floret counts, lemma hair placement or consistent millimeter awn lengths; compare S. ciliata at original resolution.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Whole dry grassland tuft, feathery panicle, finger closeups of flowering units.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Cannot count lemma-specific 11–15 awns or distinguish P. mucronulatum by mature 3–4-mm lemma body on medium sheet.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Minute distinct triangular pendant spikelets suspended on fine pedicels, hand-for-scale and full small grass.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Actual floret counts and 5–10-mm ligule unmeasured; single Hays source record.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Short stiff, flattened nearly one-sided head on a small low annual in disturbed ground.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Blunt strongly nerved glumes and ripe floret count unresolved; may resemble miniature Poa/Catapodium.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Clearly swollen culm nodes, a leaf junction, dense branches of a mature panicle, and whole flowering culms, all on same source observation.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: No visible attached belowground rhizome, opened ligule measurement or dissected separate fertile/sterile florets.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Multiple awned barnyardgrass inflorescences plus clear papilla-based sheath hairs and collar/leaf detail in same lead observation; other wet-site records.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Glume-body length, lemma awn insertion and E. crus-galli/E. muricata comparisons still need measured dissection.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Compact, narrow, green bristly spikelike heads on Hays plants. The three top photos from observation 74683342 carry historical Craig? NO: Chris Hughes CC BY credits.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Glume nerves, floret count, lemma awn origin, true ligule unresolved; three CC BY historical licenses not currently rechecked.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Narrow cylindrical bristle-containing flowering heads and leafy bases with hand scale in multiple observations.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Ligule membrane with cilia, true crown/no rhizome, and fertile lemma wrinkles unavailable at sheet scale.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Narrow green/tan contracted flowering panicles and at least one leaf-sheath junction photo.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Upper glume broad obtuse apex and fertile floret arrangement unproven; S. interrupta lookalike remains.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Source observation 62141431 shows multiple short, cylindrical bottlebrush-like plumes that do not resemble the typical large wide-branched Cortaderia panicle; other observations have single taller fluffy plumes and planted habit.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: SPECIES-MISID-RISK: hold 62141431 for expert reidentification, possibly fountain-grass type; never publish under C. selloana based on these images alone.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Two-raceme forked flowering heads in lawn-like short turf, a number with scale hand, consistent with Bahia grass morphology.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Measured glumes and underground rhizomes absent, turf planting vs self-establishment open.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Green and straw-colored dense bristly heads, both habit and hand-scales.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Mature fertile lemma wrinkling, persistent bristle arrangement and annual crown vs other Setaria not proved from these medium tiles.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Dense bamboo grove and narrow branch leaves, stem branching shown.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Distinct shortened/compressed basal internode series not clearly demonstrated; probably planted bamboo, origin undocumented.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Loose panicles and leaf blades shown in wet-looking vegetation.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Gape/protruding inflated lower-floret palea not visible at this scale.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Broad-bladed turf and creeping grass in mowed lawn contexts.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: No corky flattened fertile rachis, rooting stolon joints or ciliate membrane detail; planted lawn likely.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Wheatlike two-rowed stiff flowering spikes, some awned cereal heads beside hand/background sheet.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Precise broad asymmetric glumes, florets and cultivated-vs-spilled-plant provenance unresolved.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Coarse grass with papilla-like sheath texture and unusually tight green heads plus a roadside individual.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: No ripe proso-millet grain diagnosis; head may be immature or a different taxon; don't release.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Dense bristly flowering heads, finely hairy collar and roadside/urban habitat.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: No isolated fused bristle involucre or its detached dispersal unit; Setaria comparator remains.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Only dense green grassy mat with indistinct distant flowering branches.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Pointed underground rhizome and measured spikelets absent; cannot confirm torpedograss.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Single large arching ornamental grassy clump, with no visible panicle.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Vegetative photo alone cannot separate Miscanthus from lookalikes or document escaped population.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Several sources with distinctive nodding oatlike florets, some close hand-spikelet views, clumps at base.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Ripe terminal rudimentary floret/lemma margin, ligule and crown growth form not documented at scale.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Long spreading clustered racemes, multiple spikelet detail photos and tuft/crown contexts.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Glume tissue/seed width measurements and perennial crown require same-specimen confirmation; compare other Paspalum.

new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.visible: Silvery narrow panicles and grass bases on white paper/hand scale across multiple observations.
new_actual_photo_pixels_reviewed_in_this.holds: Reliable 4.3–4.4-mm sessile spikelet, exact glume width/sheen and torreyana comparator missing.
